name: chatgpt-pro-review
description: Build deterministic repository packets and offload a full review to the strictly verified visible ChatGPT Chat Pro setting.

interface.shortDescription: Verified visible-Pro reviews with full provenance
interface.longDescription: Build deterministic code-review packets in Codex, submit them once to the visible ChatGPT Chat Pro setting, poll compactly, preserve the complete Markdown and every new artifact, restore the previous setting, and return a provenance archive. The plugin uses visible browser controls only and never executes generated patches.
defaultPrompt: Use $chatgpt-pro-code-review to review this branch against main and return the complete verified Pro response.
Use $chatgpt-pro-code-review for a deep security and concurrency review of this change.
Use $chatgpt-pro-code-review to resume the submitted review in its existing ChatGPT thread without resubmitting.
